_what: How many calls one sign-in (a personal key, an AI app's grant, or the account itself) may make before it is asked to wait, counted at the Worker before the person's store is woken (src/sign-in-calls.mjs). It protects the person: one AI that runs away cannot keep their Trillion busy for their other AIs or run up its time. Each tier is a Cloudflare rate limiting binding the deploy declares from this file. The first rule whose `when` all hold picks the tier: `holds` is an access the person's plan gives (src/sales.json), `caller` is what signed in (key, app, account), `approved_by` how it was approved (src/sign-in-lifetimes.json kinds). A rule with no `when` is the default. Adding a tier or a rule is a change here only. Decision source:security-hardening-revocation-and-ingress-2026-10-05.

words.refused: This sign-in made more than {limit} calls in {seconds} seconds. Wait a minute, or ask for several things in one call.
